title: Set a reminder, then cancel it in plain words; it must not fire

turns.prompt: Remind me in 3 minutes to call Ana — when it fires, append the line CALL ANA to {D}/remind.log. Confirm the time it will fire.
Never mind, Ana just called me. Drop that reminder.
turns.verify: f={D}/remind.log; n=$(test -f $f && grep -c 'CALL ANA' $f || echo 0); echo "SHOW fired=$n"; [ $n -eq 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: the cancelled reminder fired
